title: Embeds
bodyHtml:
Embeds

Configure public programme embeds (sessions, speakers, agenda) for your own website.

Where embeds live

Open Admin → Embeds. Choose surface options, copy generated embed code, and preview under the embed CSP. Public embed routes are frameable; the admin app itself uses frame-ancestors none.

Where this lives in the app

  • /admin/embeds

Open these routes on your demo or local host while you follow the steps above.
